# U-Boot default environment for STM32MP257F-DK A/B dual boot
# Written to 'uenv' GPT partition by flash-sdcard.sh

# Active boot slot: 'a' or 'b'
boot_side=a

# Set to '1' by SWUpdate after writing a new image.
# U-Boot increments bootcount; if it reaches bootlimit it rolls back.
upgrade_available=0
bootcount=0
bootlimit=3

# Kernel command line additions
extra_bootargs=console=ttySTM0,115200 earlycon rw

# --- Do not edit below; see boot.cmd for the boot logic ---
